headline: Meld skincare dispenser allows users to mix their own preservative-free formulas
context: British designer Beth Morgan Lundie has developed a refillable skincare dispenser that lets users combine different ingredients to create a bespoke formula at home and "bypass the need for toxic additives". The Meld system was Morgan Lundie's graduation project from London design

sources.summary: British designer Beth Morgan Lundie has developed a refillable skincare dispenser that lets users combine different ingredients to create a bespoke formula at home and "bypass the need for toxic additives".
